result.question: 2022-yil 3-yanvardagi «Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н» bitimlarida hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan bir tonna narxi so‘mda qancha? Barcha holatlarni kiriting.
result.text:
2022-yil 3-yanvardagi «Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н» bo‘yicha bir tonna mahsulotning o‘rtacha narxlari (so‘mda):

- **Barcha bitimlar bo‘yicha** (jami 14 ta bitim, hajmi 1 837 tonna, summasi 1 386 021 150 so‘m): hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan narx — **754 502,53 so‘m/tonna**, oddiy o‘rtacha narx — **749 182,93 so‘m/tonna**.
- **Bekor qilinmagan bitimlar bo‘yicha** («Аннулирован(Не оплачен)» holatidan tashqari, 11 ta bitim, hajmi 1 744 tonna, summasi 1 316 923 389 so‘m): hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan narx — **755 116,62 so‘m/tonna**, oddiy o‘rtacha narx — **750 466,55 so‘m/tonna**.

evidence.purpose: Compute weighted and simple average price for Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н on 2022-01-03
evidence.sql:
SELECT 
  currency, 
  unit,
  COUNT(*) AS deals_total,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS deals_not_cancelled,
  ROUND(SUM(volume), 2) AS total_volume_all,
  ROUND(SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS total_volume_not_cancelled,
  ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount_all,
  ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS total_amount_not_cancelled,
  ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_all,
  ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') / NULLIF(SUM(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_not_cancelled,
  ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS simple_avg_all,
  ROUND(AVG(unit_price) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS simple_avg_not_cancelled
FROM v_deals
WHERE product = 'Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н'
  AND deal_date = DATE '2022-01-03'
GROUP BY currency, unit;

result.text:
3 января 2022 года по товару «Карбамид Марка Б» (валюта — узбекский сум, единица измерения — тонна) было заключено 2 сделки общим объёмом 144 тонны (аннулированных сделок не было):

evidence.purpose: Calculate volume-weighted and simple average price for Карбамид Марка Б on 2022-01-03
evidence.sql:
SELECT 
  product,
  currency,
  unit,
  count(*) AS n_all,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS n_valid,
  round(sum(volume), 2) AS vol_all,
  round(sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS vol_valid,
  round(sum(amount) / nullif(sum(volume), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_all,
  round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') / nullif(sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_valid,
  round(avg(unit_price), 2) AS simple_avg_all,
  round(avg(unit_price) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS simple_avg_valid
FROM v_deals
WHERE product IN ('Карбамид Марка Б', 'КАРБАМИД МАРКА Б', 'Мочевина (карбамид) Марка Б')
  AND deal_date = DATE '2022-01-03'
GROUP BY product, currency, unit;

evidence.purpose: Top sellers by total amount_uzs on 2022-01-03 (all deals and excluding cancelled)
evidence.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    seller_inn,
    seller_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deals_total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS deals_not_cancelled,
    ROUND(SUM(amount_uzs), 2) AS sum_uzs_total,
    ROUND(SUM(amount_uzs) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS sum_uzs_not_cancelled,
    ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'Узбекский сум'), 2) AS sum_uzs_direct,
    ROUND(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'Доллар США'), 2) AS sum_usd_direct
  FROM v_deals
  WHERE deal_date = DATE '2022-01-03'
  GROUP BY seller_inn, seller_name
)
SELECT * FROM agg

result.text: Ma’lumotlar bazasida yevroning (EUR) so‘mga nisbatan kursi haqida ma’lumot mavjud emas; bazada faqat AQSh dollarining (USD) o‘zbek so‘miga nisbatan kurslari hamda birja bitimlari bo‘yicha ma’lumotlar saqlanadi.
